description: This file defines two React functional components, ResidentCard and ResidentGrid, for displaying resident information with actions such as edit and delete. It manages the presentation of individual resident details and a grid of residents.

methods.name: ResidentCard({ resident, onEdit, onDelete })
methods.description: A React component that displays details of a single resident, including photo, name, apartment, phone, email, and action buttons for editing and deleting.

methods.name: ResidentGrid({ residents, onEdit, onDelete })
methods.description: A React component that displays a grid of ResidentCard components for a list of residents, or a message if no residents are provided.
